description: TOC entry whose record offset (0xFFFF0000) is far past the end of the buffer
notes: Offsets are payload-relative u32s and entirely attacker-controlled. Expected: ErrorKind::BadOffset when the 0x1003 entry's value is read. The 0x1020 entry before it is well-formed, so a reader that gives up on the whole bookmark instead of on the one entry is over-strict.
